newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia undecided on recognition of Taleban govt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia undecided on recognition of Taleban govt.

text.p: Malaysia pledged support on Thursday for its Moslem brethren in Afghanistan but said it had not decided on whether to recognise Kabul's new government.
"Considering the current situation in Afghanistan, it's sad if they continue fighting the way they have been," Malaysian Foreign Minister Abdullah Badawi told reporters.
"We hope they will be able to work for peace instead. But we have not decided about (recognising) the new government," he added.
The hardline Taleban militia swept virtually unopposed into the Afghan capital of Kabul last Friday and executed former president Najibullah and three of his aides.
"It's something that we thought would never happen but has happened," Abdullah said of the executions.
He said Malaysia, however, reaffirmed "its solidarity with the brotherly Moslem people of Afghanistan and supports their struggle for peace and national reconciliation".
